product.name: SilkGlide Ionic Hair Dryer
product.description: The SilkGlide Ionic Hair Dryer offers a lightweight yet powerful solution for daily styling. Its ergonomic handle and 1200‑W heating element provide rapid drying while the integrated ionic chamber reduces static and frizz. The ceramic-coated barrel ensures even heat distribution, and the adjustable speed settings allow customization for fine to coarse hair. Designed with a quiet motor, it is suitable for use in salons or at home. The device features a 30‑cm barrel, a 5‑cm diameter, and a total length of 35 cm, making it easy to maneuver around the head. Its midnight black finish adds a subtle professional look.
